caption_en: decomineral style, flat mineral pigments, no chiaroscuro, closed color shapes, pattern equal to form, tapestry space, a courtyard scene with a maiden leaning from a tiled balcony above, a bearded holy man in a green robe kneeling below with two companions, a blossoming tree beside a blue-tiled iwan and a pale flowered carpet, lapis blue, cinnabar red, malachite green, gold, jade white
notes_zh: Mantiq al-Tayr《Shaikh San'an 于少女窗下》ca.1600：蓝釉拱门庭院，花树与地毯纹样。
